description: System hardening and operational security rules mapped to Legion baseline and telemetry data

rules.title: Unauthorized Process Execution
rules.description: A new process not present in the established baseline is running on the system.
rules.remediation: Identify the process, its parent, and its launch path. Terminate if unauthorized. Update EDR rules.

rules.title: New Outbound Remote Connection
rules.description: The system is connecting to a remote IP not seen in the established network baseline.
rules.remediation: Identify the connecting process. Verify legitimacy. Block at the firewall if unauthorized. Check for data exfiltration.

rules.title: YARA Malware Signature Match
rules.description: YARA rules have matched files on the filesystem — malware, shellcode, or exploit artifacts detected.
rules.remediation: Isolate the matched files. Run memory forensics. Check persistence mechanisms (registry, scheduled tasks). Re-image if compromised.

rules.title: Privilege Escalation Detected
rules.description: A process has escalated or attempted to escalate its system privileges.
rules.remediation: Terminate the escalating process. Audit privilege grants. Review SUID bits (Linux) or token privileges (Windows).

rules.title: Connection to Blacklisted IP
rules.description: Active outbound connection to an IP address flagged by AbuseIPDB as malicious.
rules.remediation: Block the IP immediately. Terminate the connecting process. Investigate for C2 beaconing or data exfiltration.

rules.title: Malicious Subnet Communication
rules.description: System is communicating with an IP from a known-malicious subnet or threat actor range.
rules.remediation: Block the subnet at network perimeter. Investigate all processes with outbound connections. Consider host isolation.

rules.title: Service Installed via Event Log
rules.description: Windows Event ID 7045: a new service was installed on the system — common persistence technique.
rules.remediation: Inspect the new service: binary path, startup type, account. Remove if unauthorized. Check for persistence.

rules.title: Kerberos Ticket Anomaly
rules.description: Windows Event ID 4769: Kerberos service ticket requested — possible Kerberoasting or golden ticket attack.
rules.remediation: Audit Kerberos ticket requests. Check for unusual service accounts. Review Active Directory for compromise indicators.

rules.title: Mythos Rootkit Stealth Indicator
rules.description: Local events contain rootkit, hidden artifact, syscall hook, or LD_PRELOAD-style stealth indicators mapped to MITRE ATT&CK T1014.
rules.remediation: Treat as possible root compromise. Preserve volatile evidence, isolate the host, compare process/network views from trusted media, inspect /proc, /dev, /etc/ld.so.preload, kernel symbol hooks, and re-image if compromise is confirmed.

rules.title: Mythos Kernel Module Hunter
rules.description: Local events indicate Linux LKM load/unload behavior that can support persistence and privilege escalation.
rules.remediation: Validate the module signer, path, hash, parent process, and load time. Review /lib/modules and kernel module approval policy. Remove unauthorized modules from a trusted recovery environment.

rules.title: Mythos Alert Listener Tamper
rules.description: Local events indicate audit, journal, EDR, or alert listener tampering that can hide rootkit activity or suppress security telemetry.
rules.check_value: audit log cleared|journal file|corrupt|tamper|sensor stopped|edr stopped|defender disabled|security tool disabled
rules.remediation: Confirm telemetry gaps against independent sources. Restart collection only after preserving evidence. Review service stop events, journal integrity, audit policy, EDR health, and recent privileged account activity.
